title.narrative: Partner identification for potential NGO Project to strengthen opportunities for Youth in Macedonia

description.narrative: The Danish Apostolic Church’s Youth Organization, AKBU, is embarking on a strategic partnership journey to Skopje, North Macedonia, aiming to collaborate with a local initiative dedicated to youth empowerment through a community café. Members of AKBU will travel to Skopje, to visit local stakeholders, get a firsthand impression of the Macedonian culture and establish to what extent a partnership with AKBU will be beneficial to the local stakeholders of the community café.With extensive experience in international projects and robust administrative support, AKBU is well-equipped to contribute to this venture. The local partner’s vision to create a nurturing space for young people aligns seamlessly with AKBU’s commitment to fostering youth development. This initiative stands out in its potential to address the critical challenges in North Macedonia, characterized by high youth unemployment, pervasive corruption, and gender dynamics influenced by traditional patriarchal values. The partnership is expected to lay a strong foundation for knowledge exchange, resource alignment, and the establishment of a sustainable and impactful collaboration. Through this joint effort, AKBU aims to empower the Macedonian youth to become active, responsible members of their community, while also enhancing its own global outreach and effectiveness in developmental endeavors.
